details.description: Eleven Flash v2 is ElevenLabs' first-generation ultra-fast text-to-speech model, built for real-time and conversational use with latency of about 75ms, excluding application and network latency. It supports English only and generates up to 30,000 characters (about 30 minutes of audio) in a single request. ElevenLabs' current models documentation lists it, alongside Eleven Flash v2.5 and Eleven Multilingual v2, as suitable for Agents Platform voice agents and chatbots.
advantages: Ultra-low latency of about 75ms, excluding application and network latency, per ElevenLabs' model documentation.
Supports up to 30,000 characters (about 30 minutes of audio) in a single text-to-speech request.
Listed by ElevenLabs as suitable for real-time Agents Platform voice agents and chatbots.
disadvantages: Supports English only, unlike the 32-language Eleven Flash v2.5.
Lower per-request character limit (30,000) than Eleven Flash v2.5 (40,000).
use_cases: Low-latency speech synthesis for English-only applications

notes: ElevenLabs' models page has no dedicated section for eleven_flash_v2 (unlike Flash v2.5, which has its own '## Flash v2.5' section); its details come from the models-overview table, the flagship-cards summary, and the 'Agents Platform' use-case card. The page's explicit Deprecated models table lists only eleven_turbo_v2, eleven_turbo_v2_5, and scribe_v1 as deprecated, so Flash v2 is a current model, not deprecated, despite being superseded in capability by Flash v2.5.
